Maya (PM): quick huddle: customer Nimbus wants Private onramp with 99.9% availability, p95 <=200ms, and HSM-backed keys. Asking if we can commit for Q2 pilot. Need cross-team tradeoffs.
Ethan (Eng): 200ms p95 is doable if we constrain model size and prewarm. what peak qps and token distribution?
Sam (Customer Success): Nimbus expects 40 qps steady, peaks to ~140 qps. typical prompts ~320 tokens, but a small % go >700.
Priya (Runtime): large tail tokens matter a lot. If we cap to a 7B quantized family and enable prefix/KV caching plus 100ms batching window, we have a chance. for bigger models we need GPUs kept hot.
Omar (Infra): we can propose a reserved "pilot pool" for Nimbus with prewarm TTL; costs increase. VPC networking can add 15-25ms depending on customer subnet. we need a topology doc.
Nina (Security): HSM calls per-request would break latency. recommend DEK session cache with strict TTL and attestation. also need export-control check and legal signoff for customer key hosting.
Maya (PM): proposed MVP scope to show customer: in-scope = 7B quant models only, reserved pilot pool up to 2x baseline, DEK cache with 3-5m TTL, SLA measured inside customer's VPC (network excluded). out-of-scope = models >13B, synchronous HSM unwrap per request, multi-region active-active.
Ethan (Eng): agree, add runtime guardrail: if median seq >600 or >5% requests >800 tokens during test, auto-degrade to lower SLA and surface alerts to customer.
Priya (Runtime): will add tenant-level p95 tagging and model-level metrics. need a canary prompt set from Nimbus to validate latency and quality.
Omar (Infra): for pilot we estimate infra work 2 weeks to carve a pilot pool and 1 week to produce network patterns doc. need calendar check for infra releases.
Nina (Security): security doc and HSM checklist 3-4 business days; I'll loop in Legal for export controls. we will also define key rotation policy for the pilot.
Sam (Customer Success): I'll get the canary dataset and confirm expected traffic envelope. Also will draft customer-facing commit language reflecting the in-scope constraints.
ops-bot: created ticket PD-2047 (Nimbus private-onramp pilot) and assigned: Ethan, Priya, Omar, Nina, Sam.
Maya (PM): timeline idea: prototype + perf runs in 6 weeks, staging pilot at week 7. if teams need to shift, flag by EOW Tuesday so we can update customer expectations.
Ethan (Eng): I'll own the perf harness and supported-model doc. estimate 2.5w.
Priya (Runtime): I'll own runtime config + tuning; estimate 2w plus 1w for tuning with Nimbus traces.
Omar (Infra): I'll own pilot pool implementation and topology doc; estimate 3w.
Nina (Security): I'll own HSM checklist and legal liaison; estimate 4 business days.
Sam (Customer Success): I'll deliver canary prompts and a draft commitment statement by Fri.
Maya (PM): action items summarized: Ethan (perf + models), Priya (runtime knobs), Omar (pilot infra), Nina (HSM/legal), Sam (customer artifacts). Sync Thurs 9am to confirm blockers. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
